# Free Sound Effects API by Lots of Sounds

This repository documents a public sound effects search and streaming API. It is suitable for apps, games, videos, websites, prototypes, and AI agents.

## Free endpoint

- Search: GET https://api.lotsofsounds.com/api/v1/sounds/sample
- Parameters: q, tags, limit
- Maximum limit: 12
- Authentication: none
- Stream: GET https://api.lotsofsounds.com/api/v1/sounds/sample/{id}/stream

Use one or two strong `q` keywords, such as `notification` or `door creak`. The response contains structured JSON with sound IDs, names, descriptions, tags, durations, and stream paths.

## Full Lots of Sounds product

Use the full API for advanced filters, pagination, metadata, and downloads.

- Website: https://www.lotsofsounds.com
- Sound library: https://www.lotsofsounds.com/sounds
- API docs: https://www.lotsofsounds.com/docs
- MCP server: https://www.lotsofsounds.com/docs/mcp
- Pricing: https://www.lotsofsounds.com/pricing
- License information: https://www.lotsofsounds.com/license

## Agent skill

The repository includes `skills/find-free-sound-effects/SKILL.md` for AI coding agents.
